_doc: Hand-picked card photos, applied every run by aggregator.image_overrides(). An item applies when the card's LEAD article link is in 'links' (or its id in 'ids'). image null = WCN default card. 'block' = image URLs never shown on any card.

items.note: 2026-10-18: card showed a Dynamite backstage Jericho/Nick Wayne photo from an off-topic WrestleDream preview in the cluster. POST Wrestling's own photo of Persephone with the TBS title. Photo from tonight's show (Persephone with the TBS title); applies whichever of the 3 reports leads.

2026-10-22: card showed Ringside News' split graphic (NXT logo | Dynamite Blood and Guts poster) from a head-to-head ratings article; the story never mentions NXT. AEW's official Blood and Guts 2026 poster (900x506, via 411mania) instead. Owner rule: photo must match the story's promotion.

2026-10-22: homepage top story showed an empty dark frame (its 411mania copy of the photo failed to load for the reader and the card's error handler also removed the TNA placeholder). TNA's own official signing graphic (Shayna Baszler with the Knockouts Tag Team title belt, 1920x1080), served from TNA's CDN (tnawrestling.com og:image -> CloudFront), instead. Owner rule: top stories always have a picture.

2026-10-23: 'Joe Hendry Believes He Can Become Top WWE Draw' (Fightful, TV Insider interview) showed the TNA logo placeholder: the old brand list still had Hendry under TNA and vision couldn't confirm the photo. Hendry is on the current WWE roster (wwe.com, NXT Champion, Raw); the TNA mention is only his past. The source article's own og:image instead: Hendry with his guitar on WWE Raw (1280x720, checked by eye).

2026-10-23: WWE notes roundup (PWInsider) whose AI rewrite led with the non-wrestling Cyndi Lauper item and got a Penta photo reused from another story. Retitled in text_overrides.json; the roundup has no single subject -> WWE card.
